title: KeonDecision
description: Runtime authorization pair for S9 (contract-first): a DecisionRequest proposing a governed effect, plus the Disposition once Keon decides it. Mirrors BioStack IKeonRuntimeClient Decide-shape, ReceiptRequest (SubjectUri/TenantId/ActorId), and PolicyHash(Value, Version). Doctrine mirror: only non-effecting/commentary-only effects may take a degrading path; anything else (including unrecognised effects) is effect-bearing and fails closed (ReceiptEffectStatus allowlist; KeonRuntimeUnavailableException halts the effect, recorded here as a deny with failureStage). Local claim-policy.v1 stays proposal-side and never produces a Disposition.

value.description: Policy content hash. Unanchored rows carry 'unanchored-local'; locally-classified proposal-side evaluations carry the zeroed-hash marker (never a real policy version).

version.description: Policy version, e.g. claim-policy.v1. Unanchored rows carry '0.0.0' (RuntimeReceiptFactory marker).

subjectUri.description: What is governed, in kind:{id} form per ReceiptRefs, e.g. campaign:{id}/publish, claim:{id}, customer-finder-run:{id}.

tenantId.description: Canonical tenant key. The governance boundary the actor operates within; cross-tenant access with a mismatched tenantId must be denied with a receipt.

actorId.description: Who initiated the effect. Mirrors ReceiptActor ActorId: user:{guid} for user-triggered work, system:{component} for genuinely system-initiated work only (never a stand-in for missing user context).

capability.description: Governed capability requested, e.g. marketops.campaign.publish. Per-tool scopes (incl. keon:browseahead:scan) bind here at S8.

effect.description: Effect class. Mirrors the ReceiptEffectStatus allowlist: only non-effecting/commentary-only may degrade when Keon is unavailable; effect-bearing (or any unrecognised value, rejected here) MUST fail closed.

context.description: Free-form governed context evaluated against policy (artifact refs, destinations, claim refs). Never carries secrets or keys.

idempotencyKey.description: Dedupe key for this request. Replays with the same key never double-apply an effect.

decision.description: Runtime-signed outcome. Coarse mirror of BioStack PolicyDecision: Allowed/AllowedWithDisclaimer -> authorize, Blocked -> deny, RewriteRequired/EscalateToProviderReview -> require-review (see joint-review mapping).

policyHash.description: Policy version that decided. Mirrors BioStack PolicyHash.

decisionReceiptUri.description: Receipt URI for this disposition: keon://receipt/{id} when Keon-anchored, otherwise a distinct local unanchored scheme with the unanchored-local/0.0.0 policy marker (never keon://). Mirrors DecisionReceipt.ReceiptUri.

receiptClass.description: Taxonomy class in family.subject.action form (mirrors ReceiptClass discipline). Only classes wired to implemented behavior are issued; legacy.unclassified is a backfill sentinel, never issued by new code. MarketOps-specific classes are reserved pending joint review.

denialCode.description: Machine-readable denial code, e.g. keon-offline. Required when decision is deny (mirrors GateResult.denialCode).

denialMessage.description: Human-readable denial summary. Required when decision is deny (mirrors GateResult.denialMessage).

failureStage.description: Pipeline stage that failed (mirrors the GateResult.failureStage enum).
